question: does removing output detector 5 from every pattern remove the instance-specific change of matched requests between two acquisition windows, and are mode-5 clicks independent of the prepared state
authorization: none: the case waits for its written-case approval; it makes no QRNG read

design.unchanged: settings (seeds, parameters, columns, groups, drawn order), circuit.json, the empty mitigation list, command, gate form, selected modes and eligibility of each source manifest

veto.primary: detector_absent: detector 5 is removed from every pattern before the one-click rule
veto.secondary: subtract: mode-5 one-click samples leave the eligible count

design.slots: each (template, seed) group runs in one job per block; the groups of S1's job 1 run as S2's job 2 at matched positions and the reverse

resources.billing_rule: 1 credit per job plus 1e-6 per shot of the job's largest iteration max_shots
resources.timing_rule: 6.3 s plus 2.6e-05 s per sample for each iteration against the 300 s per-job limit; measured at up to 40000 samples per iteration, where the four diagnostic jobs ran 164 to 171 s against 176.16 s predicted; the written case restates the live qd_platform.py plan output

analysis.observation: one-click selected fraction under each eligible set; every standard error is a reference value under independent Bernoulli trials
analysis.primary: heterogeneity of the S1-to-S2 matched changes about their class means under detector_absent (bdsc_diagnostic.analyse block_change); resolved at p < 0.01 falsifies the claim that mode 5 carried the instance-specific change
analysis.coincidence_test: bdsc_stray_mode_veto.coincidence_test on all 96 instances, calibrated on its conditional hypergeometric null (100000 draws, seed 20261023); resolved at p < 0.01 rejects the dark-click reading
analysis.excess_variance: reported, decides nothing: the variance tau^2 of the matched changes beyond their reference counting errors per class (superposition, f, g), by the Paule-Mandel estimate with its Q-profile 95 % interval, raw and under each veto, and the share 1 - tau^2(veto) / tau^2(raw) with its lower bound from the veto's upper limit; it reads the size of a residual change that the heterogeneity test at 100000 trials can resolve
analysis.common_shift: the superposition class-mean change S1 to S2 with its z under detector_absent, read as a window effect under an additive, group-independent slot effect; its sign against the retained -0.0044 is reported and decides nothing
analysis.group_by_block: the superposition mean change of the groups that moved from job 1 to job 2 minus that of the groups that moved from job 2 to job 1, with its z; a slot effect and a group-specific window change are confounded in it, so it decides nothing
reported: the mode-5 share per job and block against the plan-time and post-collection dark-count rates
the mode-5 share against each job's recorded duration per sample
the position trend of the mode-5 share in each job
the seed-by-state interaction at fixed seeds under each eligible set
how many returned circuits equal their retained diagnostic counterparts
every analysis on the raw one-click fractions
analysis.tests: resolved at p < 0.01, consistent at p >= 0.05, inconclusive between
analysis.scope: a consistent primary reading supports designing a veto-based confirmation and certifies nothing

stop_conditions: --plan-check on the plan output finds a mode other than 5 at or above mode 5's dark-count rate
a retained job body differs from the empty mitigation list, or a result is not an integer BSCount
a job fails, an iteration returns fewer than 100000 samples, or the one-click rule (before the veto) excludes more than 0.01 of an iteration's samples
an iteration returns no compiled circuit or no positive result_fields.physical_perf
--matched-check finds a returned-circuit hash that differs from its retained diagnostic counterpart
a job is submitted before the previous job is collected and checked
S2 would start within one hour of S1's last execution end
a scheduled maintenance window overlaps the span from S1's first execution to S2's last
spent credits or seconds reach the approved ceiling
resubmission: a job that ends canceled before its start time with 0 samples is resubmitted once, unchanged, and its run directory records the canceled attempt; a second cancellation of the same job, a started job that failed or a cancellation the case did not order stops the case
